_comment: Aggregate grid figures, split deliberately into `verified` (found on AESO's own pages by scripts/verify-seeds.mjs) and `reported` (present only in media coverage). The dashboard must lead with a verified figure. Named per-project allocations are never recorded here. Re-run the Verify seeds workflow after changing anything in this file.

verified._note: Confirmed present on the cited AESO pages by the seed verification run on 2026-08-17.
verified.sourceName: AESO — Interim approach to large load connections

reported._note: These figures did NOT appear on AESO's own pages when checked on 2026-08-17. They come from media summaries of the connection queue. The site shows them badged as reported, never as confirmed. Do not rely on them for a permit decision without checking AESO directly.
reported.sourceName: Media summaries of the AESO connection queue

fromRegulation._note: Defined in the Alberta Data Centre Regulation, not an AESO publication.

notes: The 1,200 MW interim cap runs through 2028 and is reported as fully allocated.
Named per-project allocations are not recorded here — only aggregates.
A bridging approach allows limited early connection under strict reliability conditions, including obligations to reduce consumption when the grid requires it.
